name: smwgraphics-8x8-coins
title: 8x8 Coins
description:
8x8 coin graphic drawn from scratch. Included is a level file with Level ExAnimation set up, as well as Map16 and ExGFX (AN2) files. Most coins are set to act as 2C, so they will remain coins after a POW has been activated, but I also included a coin that acts as 2B, and will turn into a brown block.

Please give credit if used. Enjoy!
